title: typedef and enum
instructions: Two small tools that make code cleaner:
typedef gives a type a shorter nickname. After typedef, you can write Person instead of the longer struct name every time.
enum is a list of named options. Each name is secretly a number starting at 0. So in enum Color { RED, GREEN, BLUE }, RED is 0, GREEN is 1, BLUE is 2.
enums make code readable: you write GREEN instead of remembering '1'.
task: Set favorite to GREEN so the program prints:  favorite number = 1
hint:
GREEN is the second option, which is number 1:

    enum Color favorite = GREEN;
